result.description: The Northstar Arc 27Q is a fictional 27-inch desktop monitor designed for color-critical creative work, split-screen productivity, and immersive reading. It combines a 2560 x 1440 panel, 165 Hz refresh rate, USB-C input, and integrated low-blue-light tuning in a slim all-aluminum enclosure. The display is intended for studio desks, co-working spaces, and home offices rather than gaming or workstation graphics acceleration.
